name: encrypted-text
title: Encrypted Text
blurb: Text decrypts itself character by character, with unrevealed characters…
description: Renders text where characters progressively reveal from left to right when scrolled into view. Unrevealed characters continuously shuffle through random gibberish. Configurable reveal speed and character set.
use_when: An engaging text reveal needs a tech/hacker aesthetic with animated decryption effect.
avoid_when: When content must be immediately readable or when the scrambling might distract.
a11y: Text has aria-label with the full content; characters are revealed progressively.
